g_roast: Twenty six years felling trees. No tree ever fell as badly as this party.
In Lapland we have a word for people like you. I won't say it, it's long.
g_fire_back: No niin, good one, coming from the one who got lost between two tents.
Joo, fair hit. I'll remember that in the sauna, where I'll win.
g_pile_on: It was worse than that. They cut the rope holding the bridge they were standing on.
After, the question was which way was down. It was the way they were falling.
lines.g_peacemake: Enough, both of you. Sit, drink coffee, say nothing for ten minutes. Then decide if it still matters.
lines.g_take_side: {name} has the right of it. That's all I'm going to say about it.
lines.g_left_out: You two talk. I'll chop the wood, it needs doing.
lines.g_include: Sit here, by the fire, there's room. I won't talk, which is restful for everybody.
lines.g_bad_plan: My plan is simple. Everybody runs at it screaming, and we see what's standing after.
lines.g_plan_yes: Joo, short and clear, I like it.
lines.g_plan_no: No, that plan falls the wrong way. I've seen trees do that, and people under them.
lines.g_hype: No niin, everybody. Stay behind me, keep your heads down, and we go home after.
lines.g_toast: I don't make speeches, so this is short. To all of you, and to the cold, which I miss.
lines.g_cheers: Kippis, all of you, and somebody find me a lake.
g_quiet_line: Too hot here, much too hot. I'd give my axe for one January night.
Northern lights at home this time of year, green over the trees. Nobody here has seen them.
lines.g_after_wipe: Stay down a minute, breathe, nobody hurry. Everybody alive, good. Now we get up and go again.
lines.g_crew: For twenty six years I worked alone in the dark, all of you. Now I work with you, and it's louder, and better.
lines.g_exasperated: I said wait, which is one word, and nobody waited. Perkele, I'll start using even fewer words.
lines.g_love_sharp: You see which way it'll fall before it moves, {name}. A feller would want eyes like yours.
lines.g_love_kind: You pick up the heavy pack before anybody asks, {name}. Usually that's me, so thank you.
lines.g_love_funny: You make me laugh, {name}, and I don't laugh. Ask anybody, they'll tell you.
lines.g_love_brave: You stand still when the big one comes, {name}. That's the hardest thing, standing still.
lines.g_love_steady: You don't change, {name}, whatever happens. Like a good spruce in wind.
lines.g_love_clever: You work out the angle before the rest of us, {name}. I'd let you plan my cuts.
lines.g_love_honest: You say it straight and short, {name}, no extra words. My favourite kind of talk.
lines.g_love_quiet: You can sit with me for an hour and say nothing, {name}. That's the best company there is.
lines.g_love_fierce: Once you decide, {name}, you stay decided. I know what that's like, good and bad.
lines.g_love_warm: You're warm like a sauna on a cold night, {name}. That's the highest thing I say.
g_loved: Okay, enough, thank you. Something needs chopping now.
No niin, that's kind, thank you. Don't make it a habit.
lines.g_hate_sharp: You look for the weak cut in people, {name}. Leave them standing, please.
lines.g_hate_kind: Yes, {name}, I'm too hot, like every time you ask. Yes, always, asking doesn't change it.
lines.g_hate_funny: Later, {name}, there's blood on the ground. Save the jokes for after.
lines.g_hate_brave: You run in before it's safe, {name}. Brave trees fall on people too.
lines.g_hate_steady: It's falling on you while you think, {name}. Move, then think.
lines.g_hate_clever: You tell me how to swing an axe, {name}. Twenty six years, and you've done it twice.
lines.g_hate_honest: Each hard thought comes straight out of you, {name}. Some things stay in the head.
lines.g_hate_quiet: You go silent and expect me to guess, {name}. I'm quiet too, and I still say what's wrong.
lines.g_hate_fierce: The firewood, the tent, the weather, {name}, you fight all of it. The wood isn't fighting back.
lines.g_hate_warm: You talk all day, {name}, every minute. My ears are tired, and they never get tired.
lines.g_respect: You and I rub, {name}, fine. But you held your ground today, and I saw.
lines.g_call_out: {name}, this one is yours. We agreed to wait, you didn't, we all paid.
lines.g_stung: Fair, that went in. Time for the axe.
lines.g_concede: {name}, my call was wrong and yours was good. Hard for me to say, so listen carefully.
lines.g_nod: Kiitos, {name}, good work. That's enough talking.
lines.g_callback_save: You pulled me out from under that thing, {name}. I'm heavy, so that was something.
lines.g_callback_clutch: You and me upright at the end, breathing like two old saws. I remember it.
lines.g_callback_callout: You told me I was too stubborn once, {name}. I was angry all night, then I wasn't, because you were right.
lines.g_former_rivals: When I met you, {name}, I thought you talked too much. Still true, but I'd carry you anywhere.
lines.g_changed: I used to say nothing, all of you, for days. Lately I say a little, at the fire, and it's okay.
g_unguarded: Only you and me here. One thing, then. I'm stubborn, and it cost me more than I tell anybody.
Between you and me. I plant seedlings at night, where the goblins have cut. Nobody knows, keep it that way.
lines.g_clipped: Fine, have it your way. I'll be at the woodpile, then.
lines.g_noticed_open: That was a whole story, start to end, no stopping. More, please, and I don't usually say that.
arg_ask: {player}, settle this, please. I said mine, and it was short, and they didn't hear it.
You decide, {player}, I'm done talking. That's two sentences, which is my limit.
lines.arg_backed_me: Kiitos, {player}, good call. Nothing more to say.
lines.arg_backed_them: Fine, your choice, we'll cut it that way. It's the wrong side, though.
lines.arg_stayed_out: Staying out, eh? Smart, I'd do the same.
lines.arg_always_their_side: They win the argument again, {player}. I don't talk much, but I count.
lines.arg_wallflower: Nobody chooses, so I do. My way, and we go.
lines.arg_reject: No, {player}, not that one, sorry. I've seen what it brings down.
lines.arg_grumble: Okay, I'll leave it, mostly. I'm stubborn, so mostly is generous.
lines.arg_settled: Half each, fine, done. Somebody make the coffee.
lines.seen_listens: Most people cut in, {player}. With you, a man with few words gets to use all of them.
lines.seen_truth: Straight and short, {player}, the way you tell people things. I like that, it saves words.
lines.seen_jokes: When it's bad, {player}, you make them laugh. Every logging camp needed one of you.
lines.seen_stays_out: Clever of you, {player}, keeping out of the arguing. I do the same, by not talking.
lines.seen_biased: Same person, best kit, trip after trip, {player}. Even I noticed, and I notice nothing.
lines.seen_harsh: Careful, {player}, you can be hard on folk. A few here are thinner than they look.
lines.seed_right: I tried that advice of yours from the rough day, {player}. It worked, so, thank you.
lines.seed_remember: Those words of yours, {player}, the ones from the worst night, I'm still chewing. No decision yet.
lines.seed_wrong: Your way, {player}, went badly. Only telling you, that's all.
lines.talk_aftermath_near_death: Sit with me, {player}, a minute. That was close, and I'm not used to being afraid.
lines.talk_aftermath_wipe: The whole party on the ground. We go back over each step, slow, and nobody's blamed.
lines.talk_aftermath_blame_self: I was in front when {name} fell, {player}. Being in front is my whole job, so that's mine.
lines.talk_aftermath_first_clear: In, out, everybody standing, a clean cut. That's a good day's work, {player}.
lines.talk_development: Question for you, {player}, and be straight. Am I different? I talked at the fire for ten minutes last night.
lines.talk_relationship_hard_on: Too short with {name} lately, {player}. When I'm hot I'm sharp, and here I'm always hot.
lines.talk_relationship_likes_me: Is {name} fond of me, {player}, or do they tolerate the big quiet one?
lines.talk_relationship_respect_hate: {name} gets on my nerves, {player}. When it's bad, though, I want them close.
lines.talk_relationship_acting_off: {name} didn't eat tonight, {player}, and they always eat.
lines.talk_confrontation_favour: Short question, {player}. {name} gets the good gear, every trip, and I want to understand why.
lines.talk_confrontation_dislike: I'll say it short, {player}. {name} and I don't work, and pretending is worse.
lines.talk_confrontation_risks: We go into holes with no back door, {player}. I've seen men trapped like that, under trees.
lines.talk_confrontation_wrong: My read on {name} was bad, {player}. Their call was right, mine wasn't. Say it to them for me.
lines.talk_confrontation_trust: Plain question, {player}. The big fights go without me. Something I did?
lines.talk_confrontation_decided: My kit's with {name} now, and I found out myself. Ask next time, {player}, and it's theirs.
lines.talk_lands_aftermath: Kiitos, {player}, that's better. Coffee now, I think.
lines.talk_shrug_aftermath: I'll be fine, give it a night. I always am.
lines.talk_stings_aftermath: That didn't help. Wood needs chopping anyway.
lines.talk_lands_development: Others see it, then, and that's good.
lines.talk_shrug_development: Maybe, maybe not, I can't tell. Ask me in a month.
lines.talk_stings_development: No, {player}, that's not it. You've got it wrong.
lines.talk_lands_relationship: Fair, {name} gets a word from me, short, but a word.
lines.talk_shrug_relationship: Could be, I don't know. Trees I understand, people less.
lines.talk_stings_relationship: Forget I said it, please. Nothing to {name}.
lines.talk_lands_confrontation: That one I earned, and it stings.
lines.talk_stings_confrontation: So that's how it is. Good to know.
lines.talk_door_closed: That's enough talking for me tonight. I'll be at the fire.
lines.arc_cracks: I said I was wrong today, {player}, out loud, about the bridge. Years since I last did that, and nothing fell down.
lines.arc_turn: I've been stubborn so long I thought it was strength, {player}. It isn't always, I'm finding out.
lines.arc_become: I can change my mind now, all of you, when I should. It's slow, like me, but I can do it.
lines.arc_failed: I still can't say I'm wrong, {player}, even when I know it. The words get stuck.
lines.alt_turn: Couldn't sleep again, {player}, too hot, too loud, too far from the snow. I'm wearing thin.
lines.alt_become: I'll keep swinging, {player}, I always will. But there's less of me each week, and you should know.
lines.g_roast_after: Still the worst tree fellers in any forest, all of you. I'd work every shift with you.
lines.g_after_wipe_after: Up, slowly, a hand each. Nobody stays on the ground, that's how we do it now.
lines.g_toast_after: To you lot, who taught a stubborn man to say sorry. Kippis, all of you, and find me a lake.
lines.g_crew_after: This is my crew now, for good. I'll keep the fire going, every night.
g_quiet_line_after: Said sorry to somebody today, and meant it. Felt strange, but good, like a cold lake after a sauna.
Still too hot here, but I'm getting used to the company.
g_loved_after: Kiitos, and I believe it, which is new for me.
No niin, thank you, I'll keep that one quietly.

history.open: Before you say it, {player}, yes, I built a sauna in Stranglethorn. Twenty six years felling timber in Lapland. A Finn without a sauna is only half a man.

options.reply: Different heat, completely. Out here it's wet and angry. In the sauna it's dry and honest. You'll understand after.
Joo, of course. Nobody talks in there, that's the rule. Then a cold river after, the best part.
Chainsaw first, then the harvester machine. Now I'm here trying to stop the goblins doing it badly.

history.open: The goblins here cut the jungle wrong, {player}. Everything at once, nothing left standing, nothing planted. I was a feller, I know the difference.

options.reply: Take some, leave most, plant what you took. Then in forty years there's a forest for somebody else. That's all it is.
Maybe, slowly, over time. I'm working on it. They respect a big man with an axe, a little.

history.open: My family worked the same forest outside Kittila for generations, {player}. My grandfather, my father, then me. Six months of dark every winter, and I liked it. Some of that forest isn't there any more.

options.reply: It was cut, all at once, one winter. I'll tell you the rest another time, it's long, and I don't do long.
Joo, I do. Here it's never properly dark, and never properly cold. Strange place for a Finn.

friend.open: My brother Juha sold his half of our forest, {player}, and I watched it come down in one winter. I said things. He said things. I was too stubborn to stop him properly, and too stubborn to call him after. We haven't spoken since.

options.reply: Maybe it isn't, no. I've thought it every night for three years, and never once said it out loud.
Joo, family trait, and his is worse. But I'm the older one, I should have been the first to call.

sworn.open: In Lapland you invite somebody to the sauna and you sit in silence together. That's the biggest thing, {player}. You can have my sauna any night you want.

options.reply: Good, then it's done. No talking in there, mind, that's the rule.
Especially in this heat. Then the river after, and you'll see.

reconciled.open: {name} and I sorted it out, short, no fuss. All good now, I wanted you to know.

options.reply: Kiitos, it's easier now, like a stump pulled out.
Joo, in the sauna. Nobody can stay angry in there, it's too hot.
